references.text: The parallel text describing the actual execution of the middle bar that runs through the planks from end to end, as Moses was commanded.
The immediate context describing the five crossbars of acacia wood for the planks on the sides of the tabernacle, of which the middle bar in verse 28 is a part.
The description of the planks (קְרָשִׁים) of the tabernacle through which the middle bar was to run to hold them together.
The responsibility of the Merarite Levites for the tabernacle's planks, bars, and pillars, including the crossbars described here.
The task of the Merarites to carry the tabernacle's planks, crossbars, and pillars during the wilderness journey.
